title: file_slot_names() is pub with no external caller — only used privately by is_file_slot_key
detail: Repo-wide grep shows the only caller is is_file_slot_key inside the same module; the unit tests (test/application/draft_handler_test.gleam) exercise only filter_fields. Neighbouring filter_fields documents its pub as 'Pure and pub for unit tests'; this one has no such justification and no consumer.
recommended_fix: Drop the pub (make it a module-private fn) or add a 'pub for tests' doc line if a test is meant to pin the slot list.

title: draft_view.view_not_found is the third near-identical token-404 page (erasure_view, dsar_view precedents)
evidence:
layout.view_head(
      title: "We couldn't find this link",
      canonical_origin: canonical_origin,
      canonical_path: "/",
    ),
    html.body([], [
      layout.view_header("We couldn't find this link"),
      ...
              html.a([attribute.href("mailto:privacy@righttenantry.ie")], [
                html.text("privacy@righttenantry.ie"),
              ]),
detail: erasure/erasure_view.gleam:166 and dsar/dsar_view.gleam:62 already carry the same skeleton (view_head + view_header + form-container/legal-document + privacy mailto), differing only in lede copy and data-testid. AGENTS.md's DRY rule ('extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places') is now squarely crossed with this third copy.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared token-404 helper (e.g. in legal/layout or a small shared view module) parameterised by lede copy and testid; have all three views call it.
